#+TITLE: Lists Demo

Nested unordered list with a checkbox sub-item:

- top item
  - nested item
  - [X] done sub-task
  - [ ] open sub-task
- second top item

An ordered list with a counter reset:

1. first
2. [@5] jumps to five

A description list:

- Term A :: the definition of A
- Term B :: the definition of B
